query: UPDATE profiles SET full_name = COALESCE(?, full_name), bio = IF(?, ?, bio), gender = IF(?, ?, gender), governorate_id = COALESCE(?, governorate_id), city_id = COALESCE(?, city_id), experience_level_declared = COALESCE(?, experience_level_declared), planned_training_days_per_week = COALESCE(?, planned_training_days_per_week) WHERE user_id = ?
